tenderSchedule.title: Hiring of manpower on outsource for heath section

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Valid Labour Department Registration Certificate( Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the Karnataka labour department)
Achieved in at least two financial years in last five years 2020-21 to 2024-25 annual financial turnover of Rs. 90.15lakhs .

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed, at least one similar Contract of Providing Man power for SWM works of value not less than Rs. 45.07 Lakhs or Supply of 30Nosdrivers, as prime contractor (Attach Experience Certificate issued by the Employer of State Government / Central Government /State or Central undertaking boards /Urban local bodies )
Valid Firm registration certificate (Service provider needs to submit the firm registration certificate)
Provident fund (PF) and ESI Registration Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Provident fund (PF) and ESI Registration Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bankers Certificate min Rs27.04 Lakhs issued by nationalised bank
